collection.title: Volkswagen Amarok 2013 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Amarok Pick-Up 2013 Onwards model requires a 24" wiper blade for both the drivers side and the passengers side with the Slim Push Button arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle.
